reason: Forcing the effect branch to scale changes tick/destroy from setAlpha to setScale, but the only test mocks createPulseModule entirely so it never exercises this code; a tick test with effect 'alpha' would catch it.

The fallback default line thickness 10 feeds resolveGlyphPlacementRenderModel and thus the glyph texture, but the only test (progressBarTick) mocks tickProgressBarIcon so this line never runs; a real icon test would pin the thickness.

Disabling the !cartridge early-return makes resolveGlyphKey dereference an undefined cartridge (cartridge.assets) and throw instead of returning resourceId, an observable change no test covers since tickProgressBarIcon is mocked.

Forcing the cache-hit guard false makes readCachedProgressBarGeometry recompute and return a fresh object on every call, defeating memoization; a test asserting the same reference is returned twice would catch it.

Forcing the skip guard true makes resolvePositionedProgressBars continue on every bar so the returned map is always empty, a drastic behavior change reachable in production with no test on this function.
Line 112 sets slot.visible = true after rendering an active slot; flipping to false marks an active slot invisible, an observable state change with no direct test of tickActiveProgressBarSlot.

Forcing the texture-cache guard false makes getTextureKey call getShapeTexture again for repeated shapes; no test uses two edges of the same veinType so the extra call is unobserved, but such a test would catch it.

Changing /999 to *999 alters the centered() value that scales size/spacing/saturation multipliers; tests use variance01=0 which zeroes the term, but production config allows nonzero variance so a nonzero-variance test would catch it.
Changing the -1 to +1 shifts centered() from [-1,1] to [1,3], changing every variance multiplier; masked only because tests use variance01=0, so a nonzero-variance test would distinguish it.
The makeEdge fixture default pathLengthPx=100 feeds phase computations in consumers; no assertion pins a value sensitive to 100 vs 101, but the fixture value is observable and a test could pin it.

Forcing the return guard true makes sampleGuidePathPoint always resolve on segment 0 regardless of distance, changing the sampled point and normal for later segments; reachable via resolveVeinRopePoints but untested.
Changing remaining <= len to < shifts which segment is chosen when a distance lands exactly on a vertex boundary, an off-by-one that changes the sampled point; reachable but no test on this function.

Changing resolvePulseScale * sizeMultiplier to / sizeMultiplier is masked because both tests use blobSizeVariance01=0 making sizeMultiplier=1; with nonzero variance the scale would differ, so a nonzero-variance test catches it.

Changing distances.length - 1 to - 2 makes the second-to-last index return the B endpoint and the true last index fall through to a computed wave point, changing output; the only value test compares the function to itself via buildRopePointsFull so it cannot catch it.

Changing ampNoise's * 0.35 to / 0.35 changes the wave amplitude and thus point coordinates; the compatibility-wrapper test compares resolveVeinRopePoints to itself so a golden snapshot on actual points is the missing check.

Changing the envelope Math.sin(Math.PI * distance01) to Math.PI / distance01 drastically alters the wave envelope and output points; unpinned because the only value assertion compares the function against its own wrapper.

Changing 2 * Math.PI * edge.freq * distance01 to a division alters the sine argument and thus the wave shape and output points; not caught because the compatibility test is self-referential and no snapshot pins the coordinates.

Changing a reset value (setScale(1)/setAlpha(1)) to 2 in hideVeinRope goes unobserved because the hide test only asserts setVisible(false) and setPoints not called; asserting the reset value would catch it.

Changing syncVeinRope's setPosition(0, 0) to (1, 0) is not asserted by any syncVeinRope test (they check texture/tint/alpha/scale/points/visibility but not position), so a position assertion would catch it.

Forcing the tutorial.active guard false makes readAttention return null so readVeinsAlpha yields 0.5 instead of 0.15; the VeinsModule 'dims veins' test sets tutorial.active and asserts 0.15, so a correct test catches this.

Changing contribution's t<=0 return from 0 to 1 injects noise where a corner should contribute nothing, changing simplex output that feeds ampNoise/phaseNoise; reachable with wavinessSimplexScale nonzero but unpinned by any snapshot.
Changing x2 = x0 - 1 + 2 * G2 to 3 * G2 shifts the third simplex corner coordinate, altering the noise value; reachable via resolveVeinRopePoints but no test pins the noise output.

Flipping G2 = (3 - Math.sqrt(3))/6 to (3 + Math.sqrt(3))/6 changes a core simplex constant used throughout skew/unskew and corner math, altering all noise output; unpinned because no test asserts noise values.
Changing the ii = i & 255 permutation mask to & 256 collapses indexing to bit 8 only, selecting wrong gradients and changing noise output; reachable but no test pins the simplex result.
Changing unskew = (i + j) * G2 to (i - j) * G2 shifts x0/y0 and thus all corner contributions, changing the noise value; reachable via the rope path but unpinned by any noise-value assertion.
